name: tranche_a_2026-11-07
purpose: Operator/Argon 11/07 idea C: bank part of the position at a fixed profit target and let the rest run on the live trail. Uses the replay's existing T1 scale-out (target_1 = entry + ai_watch_synth_rr x risk, risk = 5% of price, so rr 0.03/0.04/0.05 = +15/+20/+25 bp; scale_out_pct = share sold). OPTIMISTIC: the replay books the fill at the target as soon as a print reaches it; a paper resting limit needs the bid to reach it, so read +25 bp as the conservative end. Baseline = live desk (rr 1.0, target never hit). Not tested here: turning the 15 s idle leash off for the runner after T1 (no knob). Same SCREEN/CONFIRM bars; a pass needs a skeptic review and the operator's say.
